cobblemon.species.brutebonnet-mega.desc: The mushroom on its back has shot up into a colossal trunk like the giant fungi of ancient times, taller than the trees around it. Glowing spores drift from its bright cap.
cobblemon.species.fluttermane-mega.desc: Its feathered mane streams like a banner and strings of beads hang from its brim. It drifts silently, singing a song no one can recall afterwards.
cobblemon.species.greattusk-mega.desc: Its tusks have grown into great curling blades and its stone-hard hide bristles with crimson crystals. Ancient records describe it charging through mountains.
cobblemon.species.koraidon-mega.desc: Its wings have unfurled into great feathered sails. The sun is said to blaze hotter wherever it spreads them.
cobblemon.species.ragingbolt-mega.desc: Its storm-cloud mane crackles constantly and its tail ends in a spiked thunderhead. Lightning is said to answer its roar.
cobblemon.species.roaringmoon-mega.desc: Its wings have joined into a great ring like a blood-red moon. Ancient tales say it rose on nights when the moon turned red.
cobblemon.species.sandyshocks-mega.desc: Its magnets have grown into great arching legs and arms tipped with iron spikes. It is said to drag whole sandstorms behind it.
cobblemon.species.screamtail-mega.desc: Its fur has grown into a great curling mane and its tail into a soft, swirling sphere. Its scream is said to have shaken whole valleys.
cobblemon.species.slitherwing-mega.desc: Its wings have grown into great blazing sails that scatter embers when it strikes. It was said to bring the dawn.
cobblemon.species.walkingwake-mega.desc: Its mane streams like burning water. Old stories say rain followed wherever it walked.
